# EzTpa
EzTpa is a modern tpa plugin for 1.21.x.

| Command | Permissions | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/tpa` | `eztpa.tpa` | Opens the Tpa gui |
| `/tpahere` | `eztpa.tpahere` | Request player to teleport to you |
| `/tpaccept` | `eztpa.tpaccept` | Accept a teleport request |
| `/tpdeny` | `eztpa.tpdeny` | Deny a teleport request |
| `/tpcancel` | `eztpa.tpcancel` | Cancel your outgoing request |

(every permission is on by default)
